description: One rule row per operational deduction type (damage / rent / fuel / custody). Holds the cap, the maximum percentage of salary, the approval gate, the schedule, and the triggering event for that type. Every rule is inactive by default so no deduction is ever raised until the type is explicitly enabled.

fields.description: Operational source of the deduction. Damage = custody damage assessment; Rent = accommodation rent / housing; Fuel = fleet fuel over-consumption; Custody (Uhda) = unreturned custody / advance.
fields.label: Deduction Type

fields.description: Master switch for THIS type. Default OFF: while off, no deduction of this type is ever raised. Turn on only after the Salary Component exists, the caps below are reviewed, and legal sign-off is recorded on the policy.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: HRMS Salary Component (Type = Deduction) posted to Additional Salary for this type. Must exist and be of type Deduction before the rule is enabled. Defaults to the shipped 'Operational Deduction' component.
fields.label: Salary Component

fields.description: The operational source DocType whose submission may raise this deduction (for example Custody Damage Assessment, Accommodation Checkout). Informational in the skeleton; controller wiring is added in a later increment.
fields.label: Source DocType

fields.description: Which lifecycle event on the source document raises the deduction.
fields.label: Trigger Event
fields.options:
On Submit
On Acknowledgment
Manual
Scheduled

fields.description: Hard ceiling on the SAR amount deducted for a single triggering event of this type, regardless of the assessed value. 0 = no per-event cap (not recommended).
fields.label: Cap Amount per Event (SAR)

fields.description: Maximum share of the worker's wage this type may take in any single pay period. KSA Labor Law Art. 91 caps total wage deductions at 50% of wage; this conservative per-type default (10%) keeps the aggregate well under the lawful ceiling. Do not raise without legal review.
fields.label: Max % of Salary

fields.description: How often a deduction of this type may recur for the same source until the balance is cleared.
fields.label: Schedule
fields.options:
One Time
Per Pay Period
Installments

fields.description: Require the worker's Employee Deduction Acknowledgment (consent) before this type posts; KSA Labor Law requires consent for wage deductions.
fields.label: Require Employee Acknowledgment

fields.description: When ON (default), the deduction also needs internal approval (beyond the employee's consent) before it is posted.
fields.label: Require Internal Approval

fields.description: Role that may approve a deduction of this type. Informational in the skeleton.
fields.label: Approver Role

fields.description: Date from which this rule takes effect. A source event dated before this is not deducted. Used by recurring deductions such as Rent / Housing.
fields.label: Activation Date

fields.description: User who authorized activating this deduction type (management sign-off).
fields.label: Authorized By

fields.description: Attach the internal authorization (management sign-off) approving this deduction type.
fields.label: Authorization Document

name: Salary Deduction Type Rule
